citation: McDougal DH, Darpolor MM, DuVall MA, et al. Glial acetate metabolism is increased following a 72-h fast in metabolically healthy men and correlates with susceptibility to hypoglycemia. Acta Diabetologica. 2018.
protocol: ~75 h inpatient fast with water ad libitum after a fed baseline; fasted 12 h (day 0) vs 72 h (day 3) samples; continuous glucose monitoring throughout
population: n=6 men (3 Black, 3 White), age 28.7+/-1.0 y, BMI 23.5+/-1.1, body fat 17.6+/-3.0%; metabolically healthy
note: Two-point fast contrast, small n. A hepatic acetate MRS outcome is not relevant. Epinephrine/norepinephrine labelled ng/mL (as printed).
